paper.authors: Tabula Sapiens Consortium (Jones RC, Krasnow MA, Pisco AO, Quake SR, Salzman J, Yosef N, et al.)
paper.title: Tabula Sapiens 2.0: a reference human cell atlas

data_source.raw_data_note: The AWS bucket czb-tabula-sapiens holds 103.16 TB of raw reads (43.2 TB BAM, 32.1 TB FASTQ, 27.6 TB STAR intermediates, 0.32 TB other) but is DTA-gated: ListBucket succeeds while every GetObject returns 403 AccessDenied, on v1 and v2 alike. This benchmark therefore reproduces from the open processed deposits, which is also what every paper2 notebook uses.
